meta_description: N.T Decorators is your trusted painter and decorator in Southampton. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, fully insured. Call 07717 216227 today.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior decoration. Free quotes, no obligation.
services_subhead: From interior wall painting to exterior cladding, we handle every decorating project with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh any room with expert preparation, priming, and finish painting. We use premium paints and protect your furniture and flooring throughout.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes that protect and enhance your home's appearance. Includes masonry preparation and high-quality external paints.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Professional wallpaper installation, pattern matching, and careful removal of old coverings. We handle tricky corners and feature walls with precision.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Expertly painted doors, skirting boards, architraves, and window frames. We strip, sand, and finish to bring out the best in timber.

services.title: Ceiling Work
services.desc: Smooth ceiling painting, artex removal, and popcorn texture finishing. We use dust-control methods to keep mess out of your home.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office, retail, and industrial painting with minimal disruption. We work early mornings, evenings, or weekends to fit around your business.

about_pullquote: Every job is done as if we're decorating our own home.
about_para_1: N.T Decorators has been transforming homes and businesses across Southampton for over 15 years. We started with a simple commitment: to deliver high-quality paintwork and decorating without the premium price tag. Our reputation is built on careful preparation, attention to detail, and honest communication from the first quote to the final coat.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our approach to each project. We don't cut corners on prep work—that's where durability and finish quality are decided. Our customers trust us to protect their homes, respect their space, and turn up when we say we will. Many come back year after year, and their referrals form the heart of our business.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About N.T Decorators

reviews.text: Had our lounge and hallway completely redecorated. The prep work was thorough, and the finish is immaculate. Arrived on time, left the place spotless, and the price was fair. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our exterior. The render prep took longer than we expected, but Nick explained why it mattered and it's held up brilliantly. Very professional outfit.
reviews.author: Claire T.

reviews.text: Used N.T for wallpapering a tricky feature wall with matching patterns. Couldn't have gone better. Quick turnaround on the quote, fair pricing, and no mess left behind. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Emma J.
